cards.title: Parlour aristocracy
cards.description: Candles and snooty airs. First one to laugh ends up washing dishes like a commoner.

cards.title: Games in bad faith
cards.description: Board-game duel where cheating is a duty. Loser owes an unreasonable favour.

cards.title: Barely therapeutic massage
cards.description: The intention is relaxing, the practice will slip. The moment a garment drops, we stop everything.

cards.title: Carnal cinematography
cards.description: An erotic film for "the plot". How many minutes before we abandon the screen?

cards.title: Dignity on pause
cards.description: Clay masks and monster faces. First to laugh loses their sex appeal for the night.

cards.title: Fighting sleep
cards.description: First to nod off admits their age and prepares breakfast in bed.

cards.title: Lyrical massacre
cards.description: Sing out of tune with the arrogance of a diva. Worst performer earns an unfair physical bonus.

cards.title: Sardines in oil
cards.description: Bath for two with a knee in the back and soap in the eye. Uncomfortable, but good.

cards.title: Blind trust
cards.description: Blindfold on, mouth open. Taste what I give you and own your faces.

cards.title: No-man's-land
cards.description: Cushion fort in the living room. A tight space for distinctly unholy encounters.

cards.title: Compromising evidence
cards.description: Improvised photo shoot. Start with portraits, end with very warm files.

cards.title: The school of shins
cards.description: Elegant waltz or wild rock. The furniture is your enemy, my arms your refuge.

cards.title: Punitive music quiz
cards.description: Name the artist or accept the forfeit. Your lack of music culture is about to cost you.

cards.title: Textile probabilities
cards.description: The dice decide your striptease. Maths has never been this exciting.

cards.title: Adult reading
cards.description: Read me a racy passage with a notary's seriousness. Laugh and you start again with a forfeit.

cards.title: Cupboard alchemy
cards.description: Improvised cocktails, guaranteed buzz. The taste is suspect, the kisses have priority.

cards.title: Digital detox
cards.description: Phones confiscated. Time to improvise hands-on games — far more gripping.

cards.title: Kneading dough
cards.description: Homemade pizza, flour everywhere. The worst cook makes up for it with flexibility.

cards.title: Hard-hitting interrogation
cards.description: Invasive questions, no jokers. Answer, or face a consequence that will make you blush.

cards.title: Sunday Kamasutra
cards.description: Overly ambitious partner yoga. Balance is optional, skin contact is mandatory.

cards.title: Mood-setting strategy
cards.description: Candles and dimmed lights. We set the scene for a night when leaving is not an option.

cards.title: Honey and clichés
cards.description: Sappy rom-com, excessive cuddling. Have tissues ready (or a bucket).

cards.title: Early retirement
cards.description: Herbal tea and a blanket, grandparent mode. Dead calm before the storm under the covers.

cards.title: Music on trial
cards.description: Demolish today's hits. Bad faith required, snobbery encouraged.

cards.title: Clay and seriousness
cards.description: Faces smeared, dignity shelved. First to crack has lost their honour.

cards.title: Picasso on skin
cards.description: One canvas, zero talent. Goal: end with more paint on you than on the painting.

cards.title: Museum of shame
cards.description: Laugh at our looks in old photos and love each other even more for it.

cards.title: Living-room bivouac
cards.description: Bedsheet fort for adults. A tight space for activities that don't need clothes.

cards.title: Puzzle negotiation
cards.description: Patience and focus. The last piece is bartered for a non-negotiable favour.

cards.title: Distant flavours
cards.description: Exotic meal to spice up the palate. Travel without moving, before the next course.

cards.title: Chef in light attire
cards.description: Cooking with the apron as the only garment. The temperature rises at the stove.

cards.title: Strategic undressing
cards.description: One invasive question. Chicken out, lose a layer. Your secrets are costly.

cards.title: Temporary tattoos
cards.description: Your body is my canvas. I draw my desires — interpret them with fervour.

cards.title: Flesh buffet
cards.description: Sensual tasting, directly on the skin. Savour hands-free, with appetite.

cards.title: Sensual pedicure
cards.description: Foot rub to release the pressure. The shortest path to unwinding.

cards.title: Forced surrender
cards.description: One submits, the other leads. Obedience required, pleasure visible.

cards.title: Torture by feather
cards.description: A slow game of sensation. Your impatience to touch me will be your finest problem.

cards.title: Impure confessions
cards.description: Truth or dare, no taboos. Refusing is clearly not an option tonight.

cards.title: A very private studio
cards.description: Making risqué visual memories. Let's hope your cloud is encrypted.

cards.title: Exclusive devotion
cards.description: Forget your own pleasure. My sole mission: make you climb the curtains.

cards.title: Primate grooming
cards.description: Endless head-scratching. We drop all humanity and go back to being little monkeys.

cards.title: Carpet bivouac
cards.description: Living-room picnic. Less comfort, more crumbs on your behind.

cards.title: Tactical thrills
cards.description: Horror film in the dark. A fine excuse to clutch each other very tight.

cards.title: Pixel duel
cards.description: Video-game tournament. Winner becomes king, loser becomes humble servant.

cards.title: Outsider-art workshop
cards.description: We build something useless together. We'll toss it, but we'll have laughed.

cards.title: Leftover alchemy
cards.description: Total improvisation with the fridge. If it's edible, it's a miracle of love.

cards.title: Unbearable slowness
cards.description: Slow every gesture to the extreme. Slowness is the softest provocation.

cards.title: Private lesson
cards.description: Classic role-play. Let's see who deserves punishment or high honours.

cards.title: Conquered territory
cards.description: Kisses or marks — I want to see my traces all over you.

cards.title: Forbidden words
cards.description: Words break loose and burn as much as the act. No taboos.

cards.title: Fat-food critique
cards.description: Judge delivered fast food like a palace meal. Pompous words for cholesterol required.

cards.title: Final judgement
cards.description: Dubious purity test found online. An occasion to mock your past with humour.

cards.title: Drawer archaeology
cards.description: Empty the cupboards and laugh at our broken, expired, useless treasures.

cards.title: School of laughter
cards.description: Primary-school-level quiz. Warning: your ego may take a fatal hit.

cards.title: Forbidden bids
cards.description: Wager on unreasonable ideas. Win and follow through to the end.

cards.title: Deadly blends
cards.description: Finish the half-empty bottles. The cocktail is either genius or illegal.

cards.title: Thumb war
cards.description: Brutal and effective. Loser clears the table or offers an immediate favour.

cards.title: Sunday Shakespeare
cards.description: Act out an improbable scene with full seriousness. First to break has lost their honour.

cards.title: Checkers duel
cards.description: Every captured piece is an excuse for one small, very personal demand.

cards.title: Staring contest
cards.description: First to blink loses. Pointless tension that usually ends in a kiss.

cards.title: Italian restaurant
cards.description: Pasta and loaded glances. Play the big game with heavy innuendos.

cards.title: Cinema and contempt
cards.description: Film picked at random. The real pleasure is demolishing it afterwards like bitter critics.

cards.title: Museum visit
cards.description: Invent nonsense explanations for abstract art. The more pretentious, the better.

cards.title: Cliché horizon
cards.description: Unabashed sunset. Pretend to be deep while already thinking about dessert.

cards.title: Safari of the hideous
cards.description: Find the ugliest object in a shop window. Judge it with royal, gratuitous contempt.

cards.title: IQ test
cards.description: One hour of escape room so we don't look stupid — or have a clean fight.

cards.title: Ants' banquet
cards.description: Bread, wine and dirt. Eating on the ground with insolent class.

cards.title: Gift of shame
cards.description: Minimal budget. Find the most ridiculous object — to be unveiled at the café.

cards.title: Groupies for a night
cards.description: Unknown local concert. Become fan number one of a guy who plays the triangle.

cards.title: Forest escape
cards.description: Get some air — and mostly, get away in the woods, out of reach of the city (and of eyes).

cards.title: Urban snobbery
cards.description: Graffiti hunt. Analyse scribbles as if they were high art.

cards.title: Butcher apprentices
cards.description: Cooking class — try not to slice a finger off. We'll eat the result out of pride.

cards.title: Bowling of the losers
cards.description: Duel in ugly shoes. Whoever misses pays the round and their dignity.

cards.title: Tropical vapours
cards.description: Spa and humid heat. Leave floppy, with a pressing urge to end up in bed.

cards.title: Hipster stroll
cards.description: Buy forgotten vegetables at the market — ones we'll never figure out how to cook.

cards.title: Sidewalk luxury
cards.description: A bench, a view, a bottle. World's best terrace for a few coins.

cards.title: Notes of leather
cards.description: Snobby tasting. Swirl the glass and drop complicated words before the buzz hits.

cards.title: Cocoa overdose
cards.description: Tour of chocolate shops. Stuff ourselves like ill-mannered children.

cards.title: Tour of the city
cards.description: Bike in town: dodge the buses and hunt the sunniest terrace.

cards.title: The gluten war
cards.description: Ultimate croissant test. Taste three and crown the king of butter.

cards.title: Altitude cocktail
cards.description: Overpriced glass on a rooftop. The view justifies the price of a kidney.

cards.title: Plant killer
cards.description: Pick a plant and bet on its date of death. Give it a ridiculous name.

cards.title: Fixing the world
cards.description: Waterside walk. It's slow, it's pretty, it'll make you sleepy.

cards.title: Sensual pottery
cards.description: Play with clay like in Ghost. It's ugly, but the contact is sexy.

cards.title: Throat fire
cards.description: Spirits tasting. Hunt for the spark in the eyes — and the burn.

cards.title: Local foams
cards.description: Try the neighbourhood's beers. Leave with a pack and a sharply-held opinion.

cards.title: Treasure hunt
cards.description: Geocaching: search for boxes with detective seriousness. For strange adults.

cards.title: Spider-couple
cards.description: Climbing as a duo. If you fall, I'll catch you — after laughing at the fall.

cards.title: Sunday hooligans
cards.description: Local match: scream for a team we know nothing about. Screaming is the point.

cards.title: Lingerie runway
cards.description: I choose, you try on. The real show happens at home anyway.

cards.title: Strategy and booze
cards.description: Games bar. We don't get the rules, but we win by sheer bad faith.

cards.title: Stranger at the bar
cards.description: Arrive separately. Flirt with me as if I were a rich, easy target.

cards.title: Improvised drive-in
cards.description: Tablet in the car, seats reclined. Watch out for the fogged-up windows.

cards.title: Scientific curiosity
cards.description: Visit to a chic sex shop. Inspect the accessories with an engineer's seriousness.

cards.title: Libertine exploration
cards.description: Discover an unknown universe. Just looking is already effective foreplay.

cards.title: Absolute discretion
cards.description: Wandering hands at the restaurant. Keep a marble face — I'll take care of you.

cards.title: Secret commando
cards.description: Go out without underwear. The secret makes every glance burn.

cards.title: Public thrill
cards.description: Find a discreet corner out in the open. Risk is the best stimulant.

cards.title: Unleashed Viking
cards.description: Axe throwing. Burn off the tension before heading home to handle our urges.

cards.title: Suggestive title
cards.description: Pick a book whose title sums up what you want to do to me tonight.

cards.title: Retro arcade
cards.description: Pac-Man and fighting games. Reclaim our ten-year-old selves and our legendary bad faith.

cards.title: Street gastronomy
cards.description: Eat greasy food standing up. Messy, good, zero glamour — we love it.

cards.title: Bar roulette
cards.description: Unknown bar: order the bottle with the stupidest name. Come what may.

cards.title: Style police
cards.description: From a terrace, judge passers-by with cruelty. We're mean — but together.

cards.title: Double chin
cards.description: Contest for the ugliest photo in public. Whoever has the least dignity wins.

cards.title: Icy licking
cards.description: Walk while licking your cone with indecent focus.

cards.title: Sexting at a distance
cards.description: Send me a racy message while we're surrounded by people. Don't blush.

cards.title: Forbidden photo booth
cards.description: Four poses, zero modesty. Let's hope the machine keeps no copies.

cards.title: Fate endured
cards.description: Let the waiter choose the whole meal. We accept the risk of cod liver.

cards.title: Back seat
cards.description: Teenage flashback in a parking lot. Uncomfortable, risky, terribly good.

cards.title: Human safari
cards.description: On a bench, bet on passers-by. Bonus for every couple's argument.

cards.title: Bowling grand prix
cards.description: Suspicious shoes, heavy balls. Last on the score pays the round and keeps the shoes on.

cards.title: Parking critique
cards.description: Hunt the worst-parked car and mock it. A pleasure for bitter people.

cards.title: Turkey and popcorn
cards.description: The worst film imaginable. Goal: finish the bucket before the title appears.

cards.title: Survivors' brunch
cards.description: Greasy food at 3 p.m. after a rough night. The warriors' just reward.

cards.title: All-you-can-eat spring rolls
cards.description: Get value for money at the Chinese buffet. Dignity ends at the third helping.

cards.title: Symbolic hike
cards.description: Walk 2 km to justify the enormous aperitif that follows. Effort purely psychological.

cards.title: Darts and whisky
cards.description: Aim for the centre, hit the wall. Lowest score pays the round.

cards.title: Millionaire dreams
cards.description: Judge prices at the estate agency. Laugh at our poverty with elegance.

cards.title: Invented lives
cards.description: Imagine strangers' shameful secrets. The trashier, the better.

cards.title: Tapas crawl
cards.description: Pick at several small plates and multiply tactile contacts under the table.

cards.title: Gastronomic table
cards.description: Bring out the big guns and the snob vocabulary. Savour before breaking open the savings.

cards.title: Oysters and white wine
cards.description: Test the aphrodisiac legend with suspicious seriousness. Briny and sexy.

cards.title: Food truck
cards.description: Burger dripping on a sidewalk. Wild, messy, fully owned.

cards.title: Haute-pâtisserie challenge
cards.description: Demolish a fancy cake with a teaspoon. A pure moment of greed.
